channel.title: Microsoft Copilot Training Australia: Insights
channel.description: Articles on Microsoft Copilot adoption, training and licensing for Australian organisations, from Addaptive.

item.title: Why teams stop using Copilot after the licences are bought
item.description: Copilot usage usually flatlines within weeks of a rollout. The cause is rarely resistance. It is that the rollout finished at the licence and never reached the work.
item.author: david@addaptive.com.au

item.title: Copilot in Excel, PowerPoint and Outlook: what's actually worth training your team on
item.description: Copilot ships with dozens of features. Most teams use three of them badly instead of ten of them well. Here are the ones that earn the training time.
item.author: david@addaptive.com.au

item.title: What Copilot Cowork changes for teams still learning the basics
item.description: Copilot Cowork became generally available on 16 June 2026. What it does today, what is still limited to a preview, and what it means if your team is mid-rollout.
item.author: david@addaptive.com.au

item.title: Copilot paid licence vs free: what you're actually comparing
item.description: Three tiers of Copilot, and the confusion between them costs money in both directions. What the free version does, what you already have, and what the paid licence adds.
item.author: david@addaptive.com.au
